original_question: What year was the device, used by M. Cuffer and M. Barbillon in 1887 to detect the mid-systolic click associated with the displacement of a thickened mitral valve leaflet, invented?

final_qi.question: What year was the device, used by M. Cuffer and M. Barbillon in 1887 to detect the mid-systolic click associated with the displacement of a thickened mitral valve leaflet, invented?
final_qi.search_keyword: M. Cuffer M. Barbillon 1887 device mid-systolic click thickened mitral valve
final_qi.long_answer: The device referred to is the stethoscope, which allowed physicians to listen to heart sounds and thereby detect phenomena such as the mid-systolic click, a hallmark of mitral valve prolapse. The stethoscope was invented in 1816 by René Laennec, well before Cuffer and Barbillon described this auscultatory finding in 1887.
